ada-king-countess-of-lovelace.b: Ada King, Countess of Lovelace is a watercolor portrait of Ada Lovelace, dated about 1840, attributed to Alfred Edward Chalon.

discreet-music.b: Discreet Music is a 1975 album by Brian Eno.

hands3.b: hands3 is a 1993 work by Scott Draves from the Fuse gallery, in which photographs of hands were sliced and reassembled by the Fuse algorithm.

hexen-2-0-cybernetic-seance.b: HEXEN 2.0 Cybernetic Séance is a work by Suzanne Treister, shown alongside the works Cybernetics and Economic Cybernetics.

nonfacial-portrait.b: Nonfacial Portrait is a 2018 series by Shinseungback Kimyonghun in which portrait painters worked alongside a facial recognition system to create portraits that are not AI recognizable.

p-133-cluster-phobia.b: P-133 (cluster phobia) is a 1972 work by Manfred Mohr, a dense field of algorithmically placed marks from the same generative-aesthetics programme as Meta Language II.

round-out.b: ROUND OUT is a 1969 computer-generated drawing by Frederick Hammersley, made with Art1 and held in the collection of the New Mexico Museum of Art.

unthoughtforms.b: Unthoughtforms is a 2026 work by Agnieszka Kurant consisting of silver dendrite structures grown inside the Uncomputables aquarium.

words-before-all-else.b: Words Before All Else is a 2022 work by Skawennati.
